system.description:
At 9th level, your combat experience has lead you to favor certain weapons or styles over others, but the right weapon at the wrong time is still what you have to use. You gain the ability to add a single weapon property to a weapon during a long rest through modification and alteration or even addition of mechanical elements. Choose from the following options to determine which modifications you can apply:

Gladiatorial Battle: Hand-Mounted, Parrying, Vicious

Combat at Remove: Compounding, Finesse, Throwing

Formation Fighting: Breaker, Defensive, Versatile (d10)

Once you have selected a modification, it applies to the weapon so long as you maintain it during long rests. After 24 hours without a long rest, the weapon becomes Damaged, and after a further 24 hours it becomes broken. If anyone other than you repairs the weapon, it loses the weapons expert modification. If you maintain the damaged or broken modified weapon during a long rest, you do not need to roll a maintenance check and it is fully repaired in a single long rest.

You may modify a number of weapons equal to your proficiency bonus, but may only maintain two or repair one per long rest.

This is in addition to the @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-class-features.Item.zzwcoeuls3eyoe59]{Battlefield Smithing: Weapon Smithing} modifications.
